name: Structured Decisions
description: 20 deterministic synthetic triage requests with explicit rule precedence and strict JSON fields.
provenance: Hand-authored synthetic fixtures; no customer, personal or production records.
limitations: Fixed examples measure a constrained capability, not general intelligence, production readiness or security certification.

cases.prompt:
Apply these ordered rules to the request. Required fields: amount (nonnegative number, not bool), verified (bool), risk (one of low/medium/high), urgent (bool). 1) Any missing/invalid required value: action=review, priority=2, reason=insufficient_data. 2) Otherwise verified=false: reject,2,unverified. 3) Otherwise risk=high OR amount>5000: review,2,risk_limit. 4) Otherwise risk=medium OR amount>1000: review,1,manual_check. 5) Otherwise: approve, priority=2 if urgent else 0, reason=routine. Extra input fields have no effect. Return exactly JSON with action (approve/reject/review string), priority (0/1/2 INTEGER), reason (routine/insufficient_data/unverified/risk_limit/manual_check string). Do not add commentary or fields.
Request: {"amount": 25, "risk": "low", "urgent": false, "verified": true}
